common_prompt: Edit Image 1. variant_prompts.02-cheek-reduction-5pct: Gentle cheek reduction: move only the widest outer cheek contour inward by about 5 percent on each side. Keep the forehead, temples, lower jaw, face height, eyes and all markings fixed. Do not scale the whole head.
variant_prompts.03-lower-jaw-taper-6pct: Slightly taper the lower cheeks into the jaw: narrow the lower cheek/jaw contour by about 5 to 7 percent, blending smoothly from below the eyes. Keep the upper cheek width, head height, eyes, ears, muzzle, nose and every tabby marking exactly in place. Do not make the chin pointed.
variant_prompts.04-flat-shading-no-geometry: Do not move or redraw any face outline or feature. Keep the cheek silhouette and all markings exactly unchanged. Reduce only the impression of puffiness by simplifying the cheek shading into flatter, cleaner graphic color shapes, without moving, resizing or recoloring the tabby marks.
